direct_observations: The first packet defines Aspect, Composite, and Primitive as contextual roles of one RT identity under a working proposition.
The first packet defines primitive ground as the first closed RT sufficient for the current proposition and treats orientation as emergent from evaluation and reconstruction.
The second packet separates boundary coupling from internal propagation and treats the computational surface as an ordered byte-array interface rather than ontology.
The second packet treats the Sphere of Influence as an admissibility/coupling boundary, not a transport medium.
Both packets preserve the hexahedron as provisional geometry and retain orientation/field structure as a computational or analog model.
Both packets prohibit promotion, execution, and external interpretation at the current intake ceiling.

preserved_separations: orientation-field placeholder versus downstream scalar estimate
unresolved_intersections: Whether primitive sufficiency is evaluated before or after reference alignment
How a boundary condition selects an ordered byte-array slice without violating order
How internal propagation changes the byte array while preserving RT identity/provenance
Whether density conservation is defined per closure domain or per coupled RT pair

formalization_gaps.statement: Contextual RT roles need typed predicates and a proposition-indexed role transition contract.
The first closed RT sufficient for a proposition needs a decidable or bounded sufficiency predicate.
The ordered byte-array representation needs explicit byte order, bit order, indexing, and mutation semantics.
Sphere-of-Influence coupling needs admissibility, reference-alignment, and no-transport contracts.
Internal propagation needs a lawful continuation operator over distinction-density organization.
Recursive closure needs input/output typing and an identity/provenance preservation condition.
Closure-scoped density conservation and 0-dof decoupling need bounded definitions and counterexamples.

next_action_sequence: Define proposition-indexed RT role typing and primitive sufficiency.
Define the ordered byte-array interface independently of hexahedron geometry.
Define boundary coupling and internal propagation as disjoint typed transitions.
Construct finite fixtures for no-transport, order preservation, and closure identity preservation.
Re-review only after those contracts exist.
what_this_review_does_not_authorize: conversion of visual references into authority
